tear verb

classical

scindō, scindere, scidī, scissum

verb, third conjugation

Other words

  • scindī — get torn

    also used · classical · Traupman 391

  • laniō, laniāre, laniāvī, laniātum — tear to pieces, mangle

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 391

  • dīlacerō, dīlacerāre, dīlacerāvī, dīlacerātum — tear apart, tear to bits

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 391

    (vōx plērumque poētica et post-Augustea: Catull., Ov.)

  • dīscindō, dīscindere, dīscidī, dīscissum — tear up, tear apart (paper, clothes)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 391

  • dīruō, dīruere, dīruī, dīrutum — tear down, demolish (a building)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 391

Examples

  • viam vorāre

    to tear along the roadTraupman 391
